name: LESS IS BECOMING MORE
text: For years, especially recently, more has been the default. More speed, more growth, more choice, more output. But as things speed up at scale, many are seeing a strategic advantage in a slower, or periodically slow, approach.

name: TRACKING TO TREATING
text: We spent the last decade giving people more information. Data was coming out of our eyeballs, driving every decision. But as our ability to collect infinite amounts of data has increased, an alternative take on tech is also emerging: actually just being of service.

name: MADE IN CHINA, WANTED IN CHINA
text: China's homegrown brands aren't simply cheaper alternatives to Western options. They're winning on performance, cultural fluency, and just coolness. And netizens are deliberately making them a first choice.

name: EASY DENSITY
text: Wellness has spent years asking consumers to optimize and add another thing to the routine. That said, shortcuts aren’t new. But what they are for is. GLP-1s have increased our need for nutrient density. And players are emerging to meet the moment easily.

name: INSTITUTIONS ARE COOL AGAIN
text: After years of chasing internet-native, emerging, cool challenger brands as a default collaborator set, we are swinging the other way. Suddenly the establishment is interesting again.

name: EXHAUSTIVE CHECKS
text: The question used to be whether something was good. Now the first question is whether it's real, and we're all doing the checking ourselves. I wrote "I checked. Not AI." under a stunt I liked this month. That sentence is doing real work now. @Matt Klein & YouGov found that “Americans now default to ‘This is fake’ six times more often than they default to ‘This is real.’” @anu has a great read on it, calling the age we’re entering ‘post-reality marketing’. This @sentimentalgarbage note Anu shared really explains the exhaustion. But as I said in the 2026 predictions, the question now is how long before we all stop showing up to platforms that we can’t trust?

name: WHICH ALPHA?
text: Brands keep guessing at what kids want, missing, and then wondering what’s happening (often coming to incorrect conclusions). The kids are extremely clear about what they want. Just go talk to one.

name: HOME CLINIC
text: In my SILVERS 2026 predictions, I said distrust in medical institutions, thin infrastructure, and the cost of care would push people to handle it at home. That part happened. What's new is the hardware finally got good, and it finally looks good.

name: SOURCE CODE
text: Everyone has the same tools and the same Pinterest boards, so the work all looks the same. The differentiator moved to where your references come from. Showing your sources is becoming the content itself.

name: THE FUTURE OF NO
text: Every playbook says take the money, take the trip, take the access. A few people are turning it down in public and betting that credibility compounds faster than the cheque does. Refusal is becoming a business model, not a moral position.

name: PARTY OF ONE
text: Americans are not hosting. Having people over is down from 42% in 1975, 12% now. Why? Being alone is more fun than ever. And the pressure is real. Yes, there a sad side here. But for a sec let’s look at the fact that the night in is becoming a category.

name: POST-PREGGERS
text: Pregnancy and parenting products have spent years tracking the baby. The new ones are finally paying attention to the person having it: her appetite, her friends, her partner. This is what paying actual attention to what people want can deliver.

name: MIDDLE GROUND
text: Luxury cranked the price so far that it left a gaping hole. While many mass brands looked at SHEIN and tried to compete, others looked at the other opportunity that was right there waiting for someone to step in.

name: SAME-SAMING
text: When everyone can build, everything starts to look the same. Institutions, packaging, products, even agencies. The same-saming is an epidemic. The only way out is thinking about mattering.

name: ROCK BOTTOM
text: At SXSW in March, I said we were hurtling towards the end of influencers. People gasped. Some laughed. I was just early. In the last GOOD SIGNS, consumers were doing the checking. Now the fakes are flooding in from all sides. If trust was the word of 2026, credibility will be the word of 2027.
